items: 🏡【STURDY BROOM HOLDER】Each broom holder wall mount has 4 racks and 5 hooks. Our broom holder is made of sturdy 304 stainless steel which means it is corrosion-resistant, rustproof and waterproof. Compared with the plastic broom rack, our broom organizer is more stronger and has a longer service life.

🏡【ORGANIZING & SAVING SPACE】Our broom and mop organizer wall hanging can keep messes organized in few minutes. Perfect for mounting your broom, mops, rakes, brushes and any other tools , saving space for your kitchen, garage, garden, laundry, closets, bathroom, office, commercial, etc..

🏡【NON-SLIDE DESIGN】Each rack of the mop and broom holder wall mount features an adjustable triangular design. The spring-loaded, double rubber gripped slots can keep a stronger hold on your items with diameter of 0.7 inch-1.3 inch. Whether wet mops or baseball bats won't slip.

🏡【EASY TO INSTALL & USE】There are two ways to install the broom hanger, designed for different installation surfaces. For smooth surface, you can install the broom holder by self-adhesion, and for rough surfaces, screw drilling wall mounted is more recommended.
🏡【LIFE’S GOOD HELPER】ZONGOOL mop holder wall mount makes your life out of chaos and everything is organized. You can install them together or on different places according to your needs.
